functions.desc: DOE effect table (term, coef, effect, t, p) from a coded design matrix and response.
functions.expr: { double[,] X = M(design); double[] y = V(response); var (maxOrder, quadratic) = EffectiveTerms(X, terms); return DoeAnalysisCore.Analyze(X, y, maxOrder, quadratic); }
functions.doc: DOE 效应表。对编码设计矩阵（DOE.PLAN 的因子列）和响应列做 OLS 拟合，返回每项（主效应/交互/平方项）的 `Term`、`Coef`、`Effect`(2×Coef)、`t`、`p`。terms 默认 `"2way"`（主效应+2阶交互），可选 `"main"`、`"quadratic"`（含平方项，需 3 水平设计）。显式 terms 遇饱和设计（扩展项+截距 ≥ 样本数）时自动降为 `"main"`，避免秩亏 `#VALUE!`。

functions.desc: Multi-factor ANOVA table (SS, df, MS, F, p per term) from a coded design matrix and response.
functions.expr: { double[,] X = M(design); double[] y = V(response); var (maxOrder, quadratic) = EffectiveTerms(X, terms); return DoeAnalysisCore.Anova(X, y, maxOrder, quadratic); }
functions.doc: 多因素 ANOVA 表。返回每项的 `Source`、`SS`、`df`、`MS`、`F`、`p`，加 Error 行和 Total 行。F = t²、SS = MSE×t²（单自由度效应）。

functions.desc: DOE Pareto ranking of effects (term, effect) sorted by descending magnitude.
functions.expr: { double[,] X = M(design); double[] y = V(response); var (maxOrder, quadratic) = EffectiveTerms(X, terms); return DoeAnalysisCore.Pareto(X, y, maxOrder, quadratic); }
functions.doc: DOE Pareto 排序。按 \|效应\| 降序返回每项的 `Term`、`Effect`，供 Pareto 图。
